evidence: manufactured convex queue-cost CPU benchmark; not real GPU, real seven-model deployment or FIFO replay
initialization: same four exact charged initialization routes; component changes only after initialization; verify entire signature against balanced archive

semantics.BO-only: disable MADS local polling; retain activation exploration and balanced global scheduling
semantics.MADS-only: disable EI acquisition; retain activation/global exploration and MADS; not pure standalone classical MADS
semantics.No-activation: replace activation faces/transitions with one full-domain space; keep domain, endpoints, memory filter and shared initialization
semantics.No-pool: disable cross-route deployment candidate retrieval after initialization; retain route-local cache/bounds and common initialization
semantics.No-progressive: request exact inner solve after initialization under the same total budget; incomplete exact solve stops search rather than claiming certification
semantics.Grid-K4: seeded finite quarter-grid baseline; not a one-component ablation; use shared initializer and balanced repeated-observation guard

analysis: paired per-seed utility differences and prediction/MILP cost ratios against reused balanced full; raw points, medians and observed ranges only; no p-values or universal synergy claim
audit: enumerate all memory-feasible deployments independently at every evaluated route; reuse continuous reference intervals, never re-solve them
stop_rule: execute the fixed 36-search batch once; retain failures, zero gains and regressions; no tuning, extra seeds, workload expansion or performance retries
